title: TerrariumVoxel
author: poooooby -- a fork of BrenoBertucci's Terrarium
summary: 3D voxel diorama for Gen 1 (Red/Blue/Yellow). Gold is an early first pass — not recommended yet. Own id, folder, pipelines and letter hotkeys; installs beside DRAMATIC_SHAPE. A fork of BrenoBertucci's Terrarium (itself a fork of DramaticShape's Dramatic Shape Voxel Mod), with an English-default/Portuguese-toggle UI and assorted fixes on top.
